<documents>
<document id="transfers-recurring">
ScheduledˆandˆrecurringˆtransfersˆYouˆcanˆscheduleˆaˆtransferˆforˆaˆfutureˆdate,ˆorˆsetˆoneˆupˆtoˆrepeatˆweekly,ˆeveryˆtwoˆweeksˆorˆmonthly.ˆ##ˆSetˆoneˆupˆTapˆTransfers,ˆchooseˆtheˆaccount,ˆenterˆtheˆamount,ˆandˆtapˆSchedule.ˆPickˆtheˆdateˆandˆhowˆoftenˆitˆrepeats.ˆ##ˆWhenˆscheduledˆtransfersˆareˆsentˆOnˆtheˆscheduledˆdate,ˆACHˆtransfersˆareˆsentˆinˆtheˆbatchˆbeforeˆ4:00ˆPMˆET.ˆIfˆtheˆdateˆfallsˆonˆaˆweekendˆorˆholiday,ˆthey'reˆsentˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆNotˆenoughˆmoneyˆIfˆyourˆbalanceˆisˆtooˆlowˆonˆtheˆsendˆdate,ˆtheˆtransferˆisˆskippedˆandˆweˆnotifyˆyou.ˆWeˆdon'tˆretryˆit,ˆandˆthere'sˆnoˆfee.ˆFutureˆtransfersˆinˆtheˆseriesˆstillˆrun.ˆ##ˆChangeˆorˆstopˆEditˆorˆcancelˆaˆscheduledˆtransferˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtimeˆbeforeˆtheˆcutoffˆonˆitsˆsendˆdate.ˆ##ˆTransfersˆtoˆsavingsˆRecurringˆtransfersˆbetweenˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆandˆSavingsˆPocketsˆhappenˆinstantlyˆonˆtheˆscheduledˆday,ˆincludingˆweekends.ˆScheduledˆtransfersˆcountˆtowardˆyourˆdailyˆandˆmonthlyˆtransferˆlimitsˆonˆtheˆdayˆthey'reˆsent.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="fees-schedule-plus-v2">
PlusˆplanˆfeeˆscheduleˆHereˆisˆeveryˆfeeˆthatˆcanˆapplyˆtoˆaˆPlusˆaccount,ˆeffectiveˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆFeesˆareˆtakenˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆthey'reˆchargedˆandˆshowˆupˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeedˆwithˆtheˆwordˆ"Fee".ˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆAmountˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆMonthlyˆfeeˆ|ˆ$5.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$2.50ˆ|ˆ|ˆInternationalˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆForeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆ|ˆ1%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCardˆreplacementˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆcardˆshippingˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆdomesticˆwireˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$35.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆCashˆdepositˆatˆaˆretailˆstoreˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ##ˆDetailsˆYourˆfirstˆ3ˆout-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆeachˆcalendarˆmonthˆareˆfree.ˆTheˆfeeˆappliesˆfromˆtheˆnextˆone.ˆNoˆplanˆhasˆoverdraftˆfees,ˆreturnedˆtransferˆfeesˆorˆinactivityˆfees.ˆTheˆmonthlyˆfeeˆisˆchargedˆonˆyourˆbillingˆdateˆandˆisn'tˆprorated.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="transfers-holidays">
WeekendsˆandˆbankˆholidaysˆSomeˆkindsˆofˆpaymentˆonlyˆmoveˆonˆbusinessˆdays.ˆBusinessˆdaysˆareˆMondayˆtoˆFriday,ˆexceptˆbankˆholidays.ˆ##ˆWhatˆpausesˆonˆweekendsˆandˆholidaysˆ-ˆACHˆtransfersˆtoˆandˆfromˆlinkedˆaccountsˆ-ˆDomesticˆandˆinternationalˆwiresˆ-ˆMobileˆcheckˆdepositsˆ(theyˆcountˆasˆreceivedˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday)ˆ##ˆWhatˆworksˆeveryˆdayˆ-ˆCardˆpurchasesˆandˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆ-ˆBrookPayˆtransfersˆbetweenˆmembersˆ-ˆTransfersˆbetweenˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆandˆSavingsˆPocketsˆ-ˆCashˆdepositsˆatˆretailˆstoresˆ##ˆPaydaysˆnearˆaˆholidayˆIfˆyourˆpaydayˆfallsˆonˆaˆholiday,ˆyourˆemployerˆusuallyˆsendsˆpayrollˆearlier,ˆandˆearlyˆdirectˆdepositˆmayˆpayˆyouˆsoonerˆstill.ˆ##ˆTimelinesˆinˆbusinessˆdaysˆWhenˆweˆsayˆsomethingˆtakesˆaˆnumberˆofˆbusinessˆdays,ˆsuchˆasˆcardˆdelivery,ˆdisputeˆcreditsˆorˆtransferˆarrival,ˆweekendsˆandˆbankˆholidaysˆaren'tˆcounted.ˆSupportˆisˆopenˆeveryˆday,ˆincludingˆholidays.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
